title: Controlled protected comparison and detached gap delivery
question: Can a source-supported comparison pass ordinary protected admission, expose each unconnected side and retain its original support in exact detached review?
method: Use two exact occurrences of one fixture sentence from a registered Docling source. Produce ordinary M1 annotations and scoped readings on the isolated native target. Derive expected public roles and extents from the fixture literal. Read the selected gap and same-case source-decision journey. Verify exact detached review and a coherently resealed support substitution.
